source: All-In Podcast — Anthropic $2T IPO, Zuck's AI manifesto, Nvidia $500B AI financing, Grok 4.6 / SpaceX AI strategy
summary: Nvidia's $500B AI compute financing platform is strategically brilliant — removes the financing constraint on TAM and creates a capital-light royalty/revenue-share business
summary_extended: Baker argues that Nvidia's $500B AI compute financing platform is a structurally transformative and strategically brilliant move by Jensen Huang, because it directly removes the financing constraint that was limiting Nvidia's total addressable market growth. The mechanism works as follows: Nvidia provides residual value guarantees to PE firms and bank underwriters, which lowers the cost of financing AI compute infrastructure for customers; in return, Nvidia receives a revenue share above a floor rate, effectively creating a royalty stream on deployed compute. Baker cites a Morgan Stanley note suggesting Nvidia could evolve into a very large, capital-light cloud business — analogous to a royalty company rather than a traditional hardware vendor. He frames Nvidia as 'the central bank of AI,' implying it is becoming the foundational financial and infrastructural backbone of the entire AI economy, with this model representing a durable, high-margin expansion of Nvidia's business beyond chip sales.
detail: Baker argues Jensen is alleviating the financing constraint that was limiting TAM growth. Nvidia provides residual value guarantees to PE/bank underwriters, lowering financing costs. In return Nvidia gets revenue share above a floor — effectively royalties. Morgan Stanley note suggests Nvidia could become a large capital-light cloud. Baker frames Nvidia as 'the central bank of AI.'
